Application Data.NAME: Gourmet Delights Catering
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Gourmet Delights Catering provides a range of off-premises catering services, specializing in gourmet meals for corporate events, weddings, and private parties. We focus on using high-quality, locally sourced ingredients that meet all FDA Food Safety Modernization Act standards. Our operational facility spans 3,500 sq ft with a seating capacity of 100 patrons, allowing us to efficiently manage culinary preparation and event logistics. Alcohol sales constitute less than 25% of total revenue, ensuring a lower exposure to liquor liability. We maintain rigorous safety protocols, including a comprehensive fire suppression system, and have no seasonal closures exceeding 30 days. Our team is committed to delivering exceptional service while adhering to all safety and quality standards.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 15, 2023, a slip-and-fall incident occurred at a corporate event where Gourmet Delights Catering provided services, resulting in a claim of $2,000. The incident was due to a wet floor that was not properly marked, and the claim is currently in the process of settlement.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel present during events, surveillance cameras installed throughout the facility, and perimeter fencing around the premises.
